marisol: Hey team — hitting a weird divergence between float32 and int8 builds when running a long-context stress. Around ~16k tokens the quantized run starts repeating earlier tokens and the output drifts. Suspect RoPE scaling or kv-index wrap. Minimal repro snippet below, anyone seen this? cc @ajay @sasha

ajay: Can you paste the exact log lines around the first wrong token? Also did you quantize with per-channel scales or per-tensor? kv-index wrap sounds like an index overflow vs modular wrap. Try --no-cache to see if it's cache-related.

marisol: pasted logs:```
[2026-03-18T21:12:03Z] step=15678 kv_index=16384 kv_pos_mod=256 rotary_scale=1.0001
[2026-03-18T21:12:03Z] step=15679 kv_index=16385 kv_pos_mod=257 rotary_scale=0.9999
[2026-03-18T21:12:03Z] token="the" -> repeated at 15690
```
Quant pipeline: qint8 symmetric, per-channel for weights, biases kept fp32. Repro command: `python run_longctx.py --model redwood-3b-int8 --seq 18000 --batch 1 --use-kv-cache yes`

sasha: Hmm — those rotary_scale deltas are suspicious. During quant conversion we fuse rotary multiplies into the GEMM kernel; if the quant kernel uses a slightly different float->int rounding or rescales the cos/sin precomp, you can get phase drift over many tokens. Two quick checks: run conversion with `--preserve-rotary` to keep floating cos/sin, and try `rope_mode=legacy` vs `rope_mode=scaled`. Also confirm the KV store uses 32-bit positions vs 16-bit.

ci-bot: longctx-kv-integration: test run 1851234567-redwood-3b-int8 — FAILED. Reason: detected kv wraparound at pos 16384 causing repeated tokens. Attaching minimal failing input to CI artifacts.

kevin: Could also be a mismatch in how we serialize the cache between inference stages. If the int8 export truncated position indexes to uint16 somewhere, modulo 65536 vs 2^something will differ. Try forcing `kv_index_dtype=int32` in the runtime and re-run. Also try padding the initial prompt to align to a power-of-two boundary as a quick guard.

eva: Another possibility — prompt prefix duplication + partial cache eviction yields apparent repeats. Try running with a random prefix removed to rule that out: `evals/longctx_kv/run.sh --model redwood-3b-int8 --seq 18000 --drop-prefix 1` (gist: https://gist.github.com/eva/longctx-debug-snippet). I can run the eval harness if you want.

marisol: Thanks — running the three checks now: 1) `--preserve-rotary` 2) `kv_index_dtype=int32` 3) `--drop-prefix`. Preliminary: disabling prefix caching fixes the repeat in the short run. That points to a cache stitch/dup bug rather than pure RoPE math, but the rotary scale differences remain odd. Opening a bug with the failing CI artifacts and a minimal trace. Will post results here. :thumbsup:

ajay: Great, thanks. If you can attach the exact conversion args + commit hash we can bisect the quant conversion change. If it's cache stitch + quant, probably a small fix in the cache serialization path.

marisol: will attach conversion args + suf commit: `conv@a1b2c3f` in the bug. ETA: tomorrow morning for full repro and trace.
